Pleasure doing business with ya. Here's a discount!

Inventory, shipment, deliveries... Am I missing anything? Oh yes! Gifts for my customers!
正面是赚钱，背面就是赚更多！
If it's head, I'll make more money. Hm... Tails... I'll make even more money!
稍微休息一下，来布拉达科医师，往这儿飞，太棒了，你是最厉害的小鸟。
Phew... Time for a break. Come here, Bradduck! Yes, good duck! You're the greatest little duck in the world, aren't ya?
这是耀光最流行的商品！看来你也很有商业头脑！
This is the hottest item among the Lightbearers! Seems like you've got a good head for business, too!
这是合作的赠品吗？哈哈，多谢！
Is this a joint gift? Haha, thanks a lot!
为了拓展事业版图，未来的商业巨子踏上旅途。
The future leader of the Mithril Consortium embarks on a journey to expand his commercial empire.
商业帝国的继承人满载而归。
The heir to a commercial empire returns triumphantly.

These colors set the perfect mood.
根据雷格尼茨家的家仆回忆，罗万少爷出生时，有钱币掉落的叮当声，经久不息。
According to a servant of the Reginald family, young master Rowan was born to the sound of coins dropping.
王都一度很流行罗万经手过的物品，据说能带来财运，其中最畅销的就是他从小伙伴那里收购的画作。
Items that have passed through Rowan's hands always sell well in the imperial capital because they're believed to bring good fortune. Among his best-sellers are paintings he's acquired from friends.
曾有人向罗万推销自己的商品，达成交易后却发现自己买的更多。

Those who try to sell to Rowan often end up buying more than selling. "I was showing him a set of meditation robes from my shop, but somehow he convinced me to buy a bunch of odd books and stones from him." —Keith of the Treasure Hut
"几年的账册，他几小时就核对完了，不愧是首富之子，秘银商会的继承人啊！"——某位破产后全部资产被罗万收购的合作伙伴。

"He went through my account books for several years in a couple of hours! The son of the richest man in the country and the heir to the Mithril Consortium sure lives up to his reputation!" —A business partner
见过维拉夫人以后，罗万曾经尝试着让姝鸳学习说话，但是它就是蹦不出一个字，只会嘎嘎大笑。
After meeting Lady Vala, Rowan attempted to teach Bradduck to talk, but all he managed was a frantic quack.
罗万很少参加各路贵族子女的社交活动，相反的，各类商业集会中却总能看到他的身影。

Rowan seldom attends noble social events but is frequently spotted at various commercial fairs. "I won't become the best merchant in the world hanging out with those tightwads!" He exclaimed as he wolfed down a sausage at the local market.
曾经有座村庄爆发了饥荒，罗万不仅拒绝了与当地商人一起囤积居奇，反而凭借自己的手段压低了生活必需品的平均价格。
During a famine, Rowan refused to join the local merchants in hoarding and profiteering but actually managed to lower the average price of daily necessities.
“罗万那个小少爷，老是追在我后面，一副愧疚的样子说想补偿我，甩都甩不掉，真拿他没办法。”——米瑞尔
"Young Master Rowan is always following behind me with a guilty look and trying to offer me compensation. I can't get rid of him. I don't know what to do." —Mirael
罗万经常出入秘银商会分会，对麾下的商人发布指令。对于利用家族势力这一点，他毫不避讳。
Rowan frequents the branches of the Mithril Consortium, giving orders to the merchants. He openly makes use of his family's influence.
罗万的篷车是父亲遗留下来的老古董，价格在拍卖行被炒得很高，但他用起来毫不手软。

Rowan's old trolley cart was actually his father's when he started out doing business. If it were put up for sale, this antique would fetch a sizable sum, but Rowan treats it like it's nothing at all.
秘银商会对学院存在的商业投资可能性进行了详尽的评估，我十分看好其中一个项目。
The Mithril Consortium recently did a full assessment of investment opportunities on campus, and I've got my eye on one with great potential.
金币、商业计划书、布拉达克一世的特供粮……这包真是越来越沉了。
Gold, business plans, and Bradduck's private ration packs... This bag keeps getting heavier and heavier.
我个人最偏爱的，是“魔法烤肉”。用火焰魔法把肉汁牢牢锁在里面，一口咬下去，满嘴都是热腾腾的鲜甜，光是想想就让人欲罢不能。
My personal favorite? Enchanted roast skewers. They use fire magic to seal in the juices. Bite into it, and it's like a festival of flavor in your mouth. Just thinking about it makes me hungry.
上一次跟佩吉吵架，就是升华庆典开始前的事……
The last time Peggy and I fought was right before the Ascension Festival...
这些就是最新一批的顾客意见反馈啊，我看看……
So these are the latest customer comments? Alright, let's see what everyone wants this time...

金穗村的季度粮食产量，确认。
综合收购方案第三款，确认。
金穗村及格罗登平原全域道路保障及维护，确认。

Ryeham's seasonal food production, confirmed.
Clause 3 of the Comprehensive Purchase Plan, confirmed.
Road assurance and maintenance of Ryeham and the entire Golden Wheatshire region, confirmed.
